projects.title: Show HN: Recurse – Develop and deploy specialist agents faster
projects.author: ozankabak
projects.summary: Hi HN! We are looking to gather some feedback on our serverless agent harness. The admittedly not-so-specific use case is to accelerate agent development and deployment. After building several custom/special-purpose agents for a few customers, we built this to accelerate our workflow at first, and now we are trying to understand whether it could be useful to others. Our driver use case was development of specialist agents with a request/response lifecycle. Think of agents that have a well established input/output contract where they are expected to produce high-quality output (artifacts, responses etc.). Especially when the problem is in some verifiable domain and the LLM can iteratively refine a result to a final value that satisfies constraints or optimizes some goal. The product is a coding agent skill + a serverless execution runtime with a harness that takes in a system prompt + Python functions as tools. The coding agent takes in the requirements from the user, and tries agent variants by executing prompt/tool variants it creates. It works best for cases where you can think of how you can evaluate a candidate agent - when you describe this information to your coding agent, it often does a decent job at building candidate prompts, tools and even benchmarks. Prompts and Python tools that the coding agent creates integrate with a harness that implements an FSM that is tuned to drive an iterative refinement process for verifiable domains. This tuning enables one to use small models like Luna to produce high quality results while keeping costs at a manageable level. Our website is not 100% complete yet (some examples are missing write-ups, not all use cases we tried are there etc.), but the system is operational and docs are there. Thanks!

projects.title: Show HN: Minimal dbt-style SQL builds with DuckDB and Make
projects.author: ltrg
projects.summary: "DuckDB and Make are all you need!" I love the ergonomics of dbt for building reproducible data pipelines with DuckDB -- particularly the ability to define output tables as individual `SELECT` queries and have them refer to each other -- but have always found the configuration and boilerplate excessive for the projects I work on. With the recent Rust rewrite of dbt Core, now seemed like a good time to consider the bits I actually need/use. Recently, I realised that DuckDB itself can parse SQL queries into an AST representation using the `json_serialize_sql` function. duckdb.mk (~250 lines `include`d in your Makefile) takes advantage of this to generate Make rules for your models automatically, and works with both DuckDB 1.4.1+ and 2.0 preview. Write a neat directory of SQL statements querying local and remote data, get a neat directory of Parquet files (plus a Mermaid diagram of the DAG) back. When you rebuild a table, duckdb.mk keeps track of dependencies (including remote resources queried over HTTP) and only rebuilds those that need it. This system is a distillation of various ad hoc solutions cooked up while working on data journalism and research projects over the past 5-10 years, most recently doing Observable-based research notebooks with Data Desk: https://research.datadesk.eco/ It's very much a starting point for further development, and contributions in line with the general minimalist philosophy are very welcome! Check out the `example/` directory for a simple test project that attributes satellite-observed methane plumes to oil and gas infrastructure using public data.

projects.title: Show HN: VNetMap – A zero-knowledge E2E encrypted network topology mapper
projects.author: vnetmap
projects.summary: For years I have used Excel to document my Home Network. If you have switches, servers and many sevices i know you know what i mean by that. There was also no good way to know which patch panel cable runs to witch outlet and what's connected to it. So I started building my own Angular app to map my network. I quickly wanted to automate the process of discovering new devices so i don't have to add every device manually. So I built a Docker agent that runs nmap to scan the Network. With the Scanning agent I also got the benefit of tracking all the devices and its state. After some development and testing, I wanted to share my app with others. The most important thing for me was then to implement E2E Encryption because nobody wants to have their whole network in a cloud readable by anyone. All data gets encrypted locally on your device and then gets transmitted to the backend. A big problem was and still is, the whole nmap discovery. Different vendors use different methods to broadcast the hostname (mDNS, NetBIOS, pure DNS). Now, four months later, I finally have a production version. Feel free to test my app and i would like to get your opinions and feedback. Live App: https://app.vnetmap.com GitHub (Docs & Agent Setup): https://github.com/vNetMap/vnetmap-issues

projects.title: Show HN: OOMU is a free macOS native desktop AI harness (local and cloud)
projects.author: jeff-oomu
projects.summary: I built OOMU because I honestly got tired of the endless cycle of installing, fixing, updating, fixing, using, fixing the open source harnesses out there like OpenClaw. I also quickly got tired of paying for cloud API tokens. OOMU ( https://oomu.ai ) isn't just another chatbot. It's a native macOS binary written in Rust and AppKit. It handles real work like interactings with system apps, work in the terminal, and compiling docs like Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF. It can also handle multi-turn tasks locally on your Mac. There is no Electron bloat, no background web services, and it stays 0.0% idle CPU when you are not actually using it. A few key things about how it works: It's as free as you want it to be. The app is free, forever even when we get out of beta. No subscriptions, tiers, or other paid services. You can use it completely through local models with Gemma 4 E2B QAT being the default the app requires at setup (can auto download as part of the setup). If you want to go hybrid, you can also BYOK your own API subscriptions. We've tested with OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, and Mistral, direct and through aggregators. This is useful if you need to do more demanding work than a local model can handle. One feature I'm most proud of is intelligent auto-routing. A small routing model sits on your machine to determine the complexity of a prompt and whether is should be handled locally or on the cloud. This is a turn-by-turn feature that can select a route automatically for each individual prompt. You must enable this feature, as it is not turned on by default. It can be selected in the chat window. I suspect other harnesses might follow this approach once they figure out that not every prompt needs a frontier model. OOMU prioritizes privacy, has zero telemetry, and everything stays on your Mac in an encrypted local database. There's none of the markdown file mess you get with other commercial and open source harnesses either. It even includes an Air-Gap mode that cuts network access completely. We've localized it into 12 languages right out of the box (English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese, Russian, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, and Indonesian). We are currently on Beta 2 (0.2.16). It is stable and handles daily tasks with relative ease. As with any complex software, I expect a few bugs might pop up here and there. If you run into anything showstopping, I would appreciate your feedback using the built-in bug report form in the app. You can download from https://oomu.ai and the release notes are here https://oomu.ai/release-notes.html Or you can also install via Homebrew: brew install --cask oomu-ai/tap/oomu I would love to hear your thoughts, critiques, and how it is working on your local machine.

projects.summary: 很多项目 CI 一路全绿，不是因为代码没问题，而是那条检查规则从来没真正生效过。greencheck 会在你的配置和代码里自动制造小改动：删掉一行、把数值改成 0、清空一个字段，然后看你的门禁还拦不拦得住。拦不住的地方，就是它根本没在管的地方。纯 Python 标准库实现，零第三方依赖，装完直接用，不用改你现有的门禁配置。 亮点 1. 审计的对象是「门禁本身」而不是被检查的代码。同类工具大多在查代码，查检查规则的很少。 2. 零依赖、pip install 完就能跑，也可以直接 python -m greencheck.cli 调用，不侵入现有 CI。 3. 示例自带、可复现：仓库里的 demo 会当场跑出一个逃逸的变异——把 "replicas": 3 改成 0（一个永远起不来的服务），而门禁只说「键都在、值都非空」，所以放行。结构上的每条规则都还成立，这正是这类缺口能活下来的原因。 4. 不夸大：输出明确写着「这些是值得你去想的问题，不是结论」，不会拿变异数冒充缺陷数。 5. 同一个思路还能用来审计指标：一个永远等于 1.0 的自评分，不是测量出来的，是装饰。

projects.title: Show HN: Canary (YC) – Independent verification for AI code
projects.author: Visweshyc
projects.summary: Hey HN, we are Aakash and Viswesh and we are building Canary ( https://www.runcanary.ai/ ) - independent verification for AI code. Claude/Codex calls Canary with the changesets, intended behaviour and team knowledge. Canary then deploys agent swarms to investigate potential failures and test suspected runtime bugs in remote sandboxes. To try it on your repository, paste this into your coding agent: Install the Canary CLI with npm i -g @runcanary/cli, then run canary skills and follow its instructions to onboard this repository. Verification starts with what software is supposed to do and most importantly what it must never allow. This means investigating how inputs, permissions, state, timing, dependencies etc interact with each other. Intent is not always fully declared as well but many expectations are clear: private files should stay private, credentials should not leak, and retries should not create unintended duplicate effects. We believe the future is a unified and independent verification system that starts with all those expectations and then chooses how to investigate each suspected failure. Source-only code reviews catches static issues in the implementation but even a clean review leaves a good chunk of behavioral only issues untested. Unit tests, integrations, E2E, static analysis, runtime experiments and formal verification are all means to establish that behavior thereby generating different kinds of evidence and guarantees. This is why we believe a dedicated verification harness that can think and reason through all these modalities and invariants is necessary on top of general intelligence. The harness needs to start with the system’s intended behavior, develop a series of potential failure scenarios and choose how to investigate them. It’s sole functionality is to pressure test and challenge the assumptions behind a change, create the conditions needed to test suspected failures and assess what the resulting evidence establishes How Canary works: it takes a cold snapshot of the codebase when called, combining the supplied intent and team knowledge with requirements, decisions, prior issues from tools like Notion, Linear. It can also route questions to you through the coding agents if anything is ambiguous. Canary’s harness coordinates agent swarms by leveraging the different strengths across model families. It compares the code before and after, traces the effects through callers, dependencies, state transitions etc. and each suspected failure becomes a concrete scenario with an actor, state, trigger, outcomes and many more runtime states., For each suspected failure, Canary chooses the best way to provide evidence through methods like runtime verification, static analysis, unit, integration or sometimes even combination of these as necessary. The agent executes these checks in remote sandboxes by seeding data, configuring permissions, mocking dependencies and third party integrations and much more. Canary then returns these findings and supporting evidence back to the coding agents which then fixes these failures and requests reverifications against the failed scenarios. To get started, give your coding agent this setup instruction and tell us what it caught and how we can do better. Install the Canary CLI with npm i -g @runcanary/cli, then run canary skills and follow its instructions to onboard this repository. We are still pretty early in our journey and would love feedback on the product and how we can do better.

projects.author: 1420079678-ctrl

github.name: 1420079678-ctrl/agent-body
github.description: Plugins as organs for DeepSeek Harness: nerve impulses route each command, a heartbeat circulates state, reflex arcs fire with zero model calls, sleep-time memory, closed-loop self-healing. Tool-schema gating cuts prompt tokens 84.7% (reproducible).

projects.summary: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 的插件框架，思路是把每个插件当成一个器官来写：插件只声明自己的能力、感知和反射弧，剩下的生理机能由内核补上——变速心跳、神经冲动路由、睡眠期记忆巩固、闭环自愈。缺一个器官不致命，会自动找能力重叠最高的器官代偿。 值得一说的是三处设计，数字都在仓库里可复现： 反射弧零模型调用。 确定性条件命中即毫秒级执行，不烧 token。更有意思的是它会自己长反射：同一个工具同一种失败重复三次，系统就写出一条反射弧，下次自动开火。开火五次零贡献的反射会被自动停用。 自愈是闭环。 失败先做确定性归因（工具缺失 / 参数错 / 权限 / 超时 / 网络 / 不存在 / 冲突），再按处方处置，而且要等那个器官下次真的成功了才算伤口闭合——不是修完就报成功。参数错误永不自动重试，因为重试只会放大错误。 装再多也不撑爆提示词。 工具 schema 按当前意图显影，仓库内冷启动基准：48 条代表性命令下省掉 84.71% 的 tool schema token，npm run bench:check 会在数字漂移时直接构建失败。这个项目本身就是在给「插件装多了提示词爆炸」这个真实痛点找解法。 不用装也能看它跑起来： sh git clone && cd agent-body npm run demo # 命令 → 冲动 → 支配 → 执行 → 归因 → 反射，离线、无密钥 npm run check # CI 门禁：常量表、目录、测试、基准，全部离线 已经装了 DeepSeek Harness 的话，一条命令装齐三个核心器官： sh dsh plugin --profile web add 1420079678-ctrl/agent-body 仓库是 monorepo，24 个插件包，其中 10 个另有一份可单独安装的 tarball。项目还在早期，文档和基准都在仓库里，欢迎拍砖。

projects.summary: 25 年年底，我当时还在上班，有一天领导让我接手一个我不了解的项目，上来就要改接口，于是就有了用抓包工具从 app 端抓包看涉及的功能都调用了哪些接口，这才有了后续我们做抓包工具的灵感，后来我想用到一些功能但试了几款都没有，就更想自己做一款了。 25 年我在 app store 看到的抓包工具还不到十款吧（现在再去看就多了），基本长得都差不多，功能也差不多，体验也差不多。一看就知道都是基于开源的版本改的。 我感觉这是个机会吧，虽然是小众需求，但能选择的产品不多，而且现有产品也不好用，于是就想开发一款比现有产品都好用的抓包工具：UI 简洁、容易上手、操作简单。把 90%常用的功能做得足够简单，让用户使用不需要看说明书，并且操作步骤能一步完成就不要让用户操作两步。 第一个版本只做了几个核心功能，但用了一个月时间写完，因审核问题，又延迟一个月，到 26 年 1 月低才上架成功。 ![]( https://apicatcher.net/apicatcher.webp) 当时我其实没有了解到有 Proxyman 这款产品，我发布后不久才发现的，因为我没去做什么调研，只在 AppStore 上搜索有哪些抓包工具，而 Proxyman 又没有上架中国。 所以后面当我了解到 Proxyman 后，也是看 Proxyman 提供哪些功能我们还没有的就加上了，ApiCatcher 的功能才慢慢增多。 我并不想在价格上做优势，面向全球用户，Proxyman 定价多少我们也定价多少，我们想卷的是用户体验！ 这半年我大部分时间都投入到了 ApiCatcher ，从开发 iOS 版本，到开发桌面端，再到 Android 端，目前已经支持 iOS 、Android 、Windows 、macOS 四个平台。也做了 Burp Suite 插件，能够在移动设备上实时捕获 HTTP/HTTPS 流量并实时传到 Burp Suite 上分析。还开放了实时同步协议，让所有用户都能实现自己开发接收端，实现类似 Burp Suite 插件这样的需求，这其实也是用户向我们提的需求。 在完成几个端的开发后，我们开始优化产品的一些细节体验，细节是最难描述的，但如果用过 ApiCatcher ，应该能感受到一些细节上的用心，举几个例子： - 编辑请求头时会提供常见请求头 key 和 value 选项（能选就不输入，因为记不住，还得去搜索复制）。 - 写脚本提供 AI 生成，APP 将请求自动生成 API 文档加入系统提示词，用户只需要描述需求就能生成脚本，生成的脚本还可以从历史请求中选择一个请求测试，不仅能查看结果还能看脚本打印的日志。 - 写正则表达式不会写？ AI 一键生成，生成后可以选择一个请求测试，测试失败可以一键修复。 ..... 这样的细节非常多，在此不过多介绍，说再多不如上手体验。 ![]( https://apicatcher.net/apicatcher-ai-assistant.webp) Proxyman 做的一些 AI 功能我们并不想做，不想为了做而做。我们加入 AI 更想让 AI 做擅长的事情、做真正用户需要的事情：帮生成正则表达式、帮生成 cron 表达式、帮生成脚本等。 抓包工具那么多，但用户需求的功能就那几个，所以我们要做的并不是跟 Proxyman 等抓包工具比谁的功能更多、比谁的功能更强，而是在用户实际需求、常用的功能上，比谁的体验用户更喜欢。当然，我们不会做推广，知道 Proxyman 的用户并不知道 ApiCatcher 。 ![]( https://apicatcher.net/pc/ui2/apicatcher-mac-request-details-tab-view.webp) [ApiCatcher]( https://apicatcher.net)的抓包功能是免费的，欢迎大家下载体验！ 官网： https://apicatcher.net 这里也赠送几个终身会员免费优惠链接：(在 iOS 上点击链接跳转到 AppStore 领取) 4XNLWHMLM3TY4RAJTT,https://apps.apple.com/redeem?ctx=offercodes&id=6757103562&code=4XNLWHMLM3TY4RAJTT 3AAEL7TL8EK67WNEM4,https://apps.apple.com/redeem?ctx=offercodes&id=6757103562&code=3AAEL7TL8EK67WNEM4 MAR8LAE8XMNLW4JYPE,https://apps.apple.com/redeem?ctx=offercodes&id=6757103562&code=MAR8LAE8XMNLW4JYPE 3WA83RPW6M4633XNAW,https://apps.apple.com/redeem?ctx=offercodes&id=6757103562&code=3WA83RPW6M4633XNAW FPHFLNK8TEWT6T7X43,https://apps.apple.com/redeem?ctx=offercodes&id=6757103562&code=FPHFLNK8TEWT6T7X43 NERKHXYLENPJ4MFK4N,https://apps.apple.com/redeem?ctx=offercodes&id=6757103562&code=NERKHXYLENPJ4MFK4N

projects.title: Show HN: Tlx – E2E chat over SSH under 500 lines of code
projects.author: achempion
projects.summary: This is a reference implementation of encrypted chats for small trusted groups. It runs SSH server in a container that acts as a mailbox for opaque encrypted blobs (145 lines of code). SSH keys serve as an identity. Then a local demon syncs and decrypts these blobs into SQLite database (321 lines of code). I wanted to make crypto as simple as possible and have only widely used and well audited components. Relay server and sync demon are implemented in standard Python without any extra dependencies. I've chosen Python as it ships with SQLite client in standard library. Could have used go/rust, but wanted to keep reference implementation as simple as possible with minimal dependencies.

projects.title: [开源推荐] precheck：让你的 AI agent 用「它无权编写」的检查自证
projects.author: simin-yuan

github.name: simin-yuan/precheck
github.description: Make an agent prove its claims with checks it was not allowed to write. The check is frozen before the run, then audited for the ability to fail at all.

projects.summary: AI agent 说它做完了，你现在只有两个选择：信它，或者自己把 diff 重看一遍。precheck 给第三个选项。它做两件测试框架不会做的事：第一，验收检查必须在动工之前写好并被哈希锁死，所以干活的那一方没法把考试题目改成自己会的；事后改一个字，之前所有结论全部作废——这是可验证的，不是靠约定。第二，检查通过之后，它会把被检查的产物改坏再跑一遍；在坏输入上照样通过的检查，从来就不是证据。 亮点 1. 审计的对象是「证明本身」。pytest 问的是「代码对不对」，precheck 问的是「你的证明对不对」——后者目前几乎没有工具。 2. 预注册是机制不是口号：检查在开工前冻结入哈希链，precheck verify 一条命令就能查出事后改动、删条目、跳序号。任何人拿到仓库都能自己验，不需要信任你。 3. 变异审计带具体改动：4 种变异（删行 / 置空 / 改数 / 截断）确定性地改坏产物再跑，逃逸的检查逐条列出改成了什么，比如 replicas: 3 -> 0 —— 一个永远起不来的服务，检查照样说通过。 4. 零依赖纯标准库、不联网、不侵入现有 CI；19 个单测；Linux / Windows / macOS × Python 3.8–3.13 全绿（9/9）。自带 composite GitHub Action。 5. 不夸大：输出明确写着「这是问题列表，不是 bug 列表」，README 有独立的 Limits 段落讲清它证明不了什么——包括「哈希链只能证明历史没被事后改动，不能证明第一条记录是诚实的」。

projects.title: Show HN: Little Memory 2.0, one-line-a-day journal, offline-first
projects.author: ivantse
projects.summary: I launched Little Memory in 2011 as a Rails app, with the iOS app following in 2012. You write one line about your day, and a year later it comes back to you. Everyone's entries lived in my database, which always made me feel uneasy: if something ever happened to me, someone else would have to keep the servers running just so people could keep using their own diaries. Over the years, people have written over 1 million memories in it. 2.0 is a full rewrite, and it's offline-first. Entries live on the phone (with iCloud sync). You can write in your diary without an account, and your private and personal data stays in your control and in your phone rather than on my servers. It's iOS only, free to download, with a premium upgrade (lifetime/subscription). The import/migration took the biggest chunk of the project. Many long-time users have thousands of entries. I used to let people add entries via SMS, and running the importer during the TestFlight beta turned up a bug from that: Twilio split long messages into separate webhooks with no shared message ID, and they didn't always arrive in order, so an app designed around one entry per day had been writing two on a single day. The beta found a concurrency bug that silently failed to attach photos, and some people had thousands of photos to import, so I set up background tasks since no one's keeping the app open for long periods of time. I wrote more about the rewrite here: https://ivanthinking.net/2026/09/22/little-memory-2.0-moving... Thanks for reading, and I hope you try it out. I'd love to hear any feedback you have. Ivan ivan@thelittlememory.com

projects.title: Show HN: IttyBittyAI – Qwen2.5:0.5B running on a 2017 Asus smartphone
projects.author: spottedmarley
projects.summary: Rummaging through some boxes of old stuff, I found one of my old smart phones. It's an Asus Zenfone 4 Max (ZC554KL, Snapdragon 430, 8x Cortex-A53, 3 GB RAM, 32 GB storage) that I bought back in 2017 and so it's been sitting in a box for ~8 or 9 years. Still works! So I thought I'd give it a chance to avoid the garbage bin by turning it into a tiny AI chatbot server that can connect to any wifi network and immediately make itself available to chat via a web UI on the local network. The phone now boots into postmarketOS, with a small touch screen UI for picking a Wi-Fi network. Once connected, the web server is started and a chat URL provided (the app sets the device hostname to ittybitty so the standard chat URL will be http://ittybitty.local or just the IP address) and a QR code that will take you to the chat UI is provided. llama.cpp was compiled on the phone itself (the first full build took over an hour). The model is Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct at 4-bit (403 MB). It can't really do a whole lot other than chat and answer questions using it's training data, which is tiny so not super-intelligent on its own, but I added a few helpers to the web app (a calculator, the date/time, Wikipedia lookups). This project was mostly just to see if it would work at all , so the results were relatively impressive. What I'm seeing: - ~4.5 tokens/sec generating (generally faster than you can read the output being generated), ~13 tokens/sec reading the prompt - llama-server uses about 570 MB of RAM with the model loaded - two people can chat at once, users wait their turn - I tried SmolLM2-360M first, it was faster (6 tok/s) but it looped and refused to answer things. The 0.5B model is noticeably better at holding a conversation. The coolest thing is it's portability. Anywhere you go that has a wifi to connect to you can just turn the phone on, connect it to the wifi, and now that network has a little AI chat bot to talk to. If this old crappy smart phone does this well I can only imagine how newer, better, faster, bigger phones would do. If anybody has this same smart phone and is interested in doing the same thing just let me know and I can give you the custom OS and llamacpp builds to start from. Not a whole lot to 'show' since it runs inside my local network but here are some screenshots of the mobile app/server and the web UI: https://spottedmarley.com/ittybitty-home.png https://spottedmarley.com/ittybitty-ui.jpg

projects.author: GorillaMoe
projects.summary: Full E2EE Cross-Platform (MacOS <-> Windows <-> Linux) P2P Mesh. This project started almost 2 years ago (by that time it went with the name "Bananas Screen Sharing", which still yields results on Google) and has come a long way. This started, because I was fed up with the lack of proper screenshare support on Linux (even when supported, the clients degrade to only being able to view, but not really participate). Additionally, I got tired of this dance: "Here.. no.. almost.. a bit to the top.. yeah, almost.. no.. more to the right.." .. when someone is sharing the screen and I try to help them navigate.. This is why p2p.kiwi supports multiple virtual cursors (they can't take control, but on double-click, they make a long sound on the presenter and grow in size..). The kiwi also supports full remote control (mouse and/or keyboard) with an emergency eject key-chord (if people start typing rm -rf, you'd better press the emergency chord quickly..). There is no p2p.kiwi cloud and no forced accounts. Think of it as Skype's nerdy little sister, but E2EE, Chat, Voice, Screenshare, Remote-Controls, a P2P mesh network and completely free and open-source.

projects.author: YehuiTang0316

github.name: rsi-gear/gear
github.description: Gear (General Evolution Architecture) is RSI infrastructure for AI agents. Use Gear to refine agent harnesses.

projects.summary: 大家好，自荐一个开源项目 Gear，希望帮助开发者提升 AI Agent 在具体任务中的表现。 开发 Agent 时，经常需要反复调整提示词、工具和执行流程，再跑一遍任务，检查改动是否有效。Gear 把这个过程组织成一个由评测反馈驱动的优化循环： 1. 准备一组有明确验收标准的任务，可以使用现有 benchmark，也可以定义自己的任务集。 2. 运行 Agent，收集执行轨迹和评测结果。 3. 由负责优化的 Agent 分析失败原因，修改授权范围内的组件。 4. 重新评测、比较候选版本，保留表现更好的方案，继续迭代。 可优化的组件包括提示词、工具实现、Skills、工作流和上下文管理。这些围绕模型的运行配置统称为 harness。Gear 会记录各版本的改动和评测结果，方便检查和复用；开发者也可以定制搜索算法，并根据通过率、费用或 token 消耗设置优化目标。 在项目公开的 AutomationBench Marketing 实验中，GPT 5.6 Luna + DSH 在 100 个公开任务上的任务通过率从 27% 提升到 53%，目标完成率从 75.37% 提升到 88.88%。这组结果包含 harness 优化和推理档位从 medium 到 max 的变化，且任务集参与过优化；实验配置与评分口径均已公开，便于读者判断结果的适用范围。 Gear 通过 Refine Skill 接入 Codex、Claude Code、DSH 等 Agent 环境。负责提出改进的 Agent 与执行任务的 Agent 可以使用不同模型。当前已支持 harness 优化，模型训练仍处于实验阶段。 项目采用 MIT 协议，提供中文文档和完整实验案例，欢迎试用、反馈和贡献。 GitHub 源码 中文文档与快速开始 实验过程与优化算法

projects.title: 左屏让 AI 写代码，右屏开着直播：做了两个 Mac 小工具 LiveHub + Vunio
projects.author: wils
projects.summary: 平时我指挥 AI 干活的时候，另一块屏幕上基本一直开着直播，DOTA 比赛、游戏区、聊天台都有。代码交给 AI 跑，自己偶尔瞄一眼弹幕，这种半专注的状态对我来说特别舒服。 问题是直播分散在抖音、斗鱼、虎牙、B 站四个平台，每个都要开网页或者装客户端，又重又吵。所以给自己做了两个小工具，用下来还挺顺手，拿出来分享一下。 ![左屏写代码，右屏听直播]( https://vunio.willsuo.com/press/04-livehub-vunio-desk.jpg) ## LiveHub：四个平台的直播间放在一个目录里 - 抖音、斗鱼、虎牙、哔哩哔哩的直播间聚合在一起，按平台、分类筛选，按在线人数排序，也能搜主播、房间和分类 - 点「使用播放器」直接拿直连流，交给本机任意第三方播放器播放（ IINA 、mpv 、VLC 、PotPlayer 等都行），不走网页、不用登录 - **弹幕只有用我的播放器 Vunio 打开时才能看到**：其他播放器只能拿到画面和声音 - 弹幕可以按类型过滤，默认只留聊天，进场、点赞、礼物这类通知不再刷屏 - 免费开源（ GPL-3.0 ），macOS （ Apple Silicon ）和 Windows x64 都有安装包： https://github.com/WillSuo-Github/livehub-desktop/releases/latest ## Vunio：Mac / iPhone 原生播放器 LiveHub 可以用任何播放器看直播，但只有交给 Vunio 的时候会把弹幕一起带过去，画面上才是直播 + 弹幕。窗口可以随便缩小丢在副屏角落，也能画中画。 除了看直播，它平时也是我的本地/NAS 播放器： - 基于 libVLC ，MKV 、HDR / 杜比视界、TrueHD / DTS 、ASS / PGS 字幕都能直接播 - 自带 SMB 、NFS 、SFTP 、FTP 、WebDAV 浏览，不用先挂载，iPhone 上也能直接进共享播放 - 字幕按文件哈希匹配（ OpenSubtitles / 射手网），可以同时开两条字幕 - 界面支持简体中文、繁體中文等 30 多种语言，无账号、无广告 ![Vunio 播放]( https://vunio.willsuo.com/press/01-playback-formats.jpg) ![Vunio 直接浏览 NAS]( https://vunio.willsuo.com/press/02-network-shares.jpg) Vunio 目前在 TestFlight 公测，Mac 和 iPhone 同一个链接，需要 iOS 26 / macOS 26： https://vunio.willsuo.com/tf/v2ex/ ## 目前的限制 - Vunio 还没上 App Store ，只有 TestFlight - 弹幕只在 LiveHub + Mac 版 Vunio 这个组合里有，用 IINA 、VLC 等其他播放器只能看直播画面 - LiveHub 用的是各平台公开接口，平台风控或接口变动时个别直播间会拉不到流 - LiveHub 的 Windows 包没有签名，第一次打开 SmartScreen 会提示 两个都是我自己一个人在做，有 bug 、想要的功能、哪个平台的直播间打不开，都欢迎回帖或者到 Discord 找我： https://vunio.willsuo.com/community

projects.title: AnyFileKit：26 个文件工具，文件不上传，全部在浏览器里跑
projects.author: lizhi5753186
projects.summary: 自荐一下我自己做的 AnyFileKit → 起因是每次压张图、转个 PDF，都得先把文件传到别人服务器上，等它处理完再下回来。文件不重要的时候无所谓，是合同或者证件扫描件的时候就有点别扭。 所以这个站里 26 个工具全都在浏览器里跑：压缩图片 / PDF / 视频，PDF 转 JPG 或可编辑的 Word，HEIC 转 JPG，图片转 PDF，视频转 MP3 或 GIF，Markdown 转 Word 或 PPT，合并和拆分 PDF，按工作表或按行拆分 Excel，裁剪和剪辑视频，多图拼接，还有图片转文字（六种语言）。 选完文件之后是页面里的 JavaScript 直接把它读进来，没有上传这一步。这句不用信我说的，打开开发者工具切到 Network 面板，随便用一个工具，除了页面自己的代码之外不会再有任何请求。 也因为没有上传，就没人替你设大小上限，能处理多大取决于你自己的电脑，2.2 GB 的视频在普通笔记本上打得开。不用注册，没有水印。 有两件事得说在前面。一是三个 AI 翻译（PDF / 图片 / 视频）做不到全本地，模型太大跑不动，送出去的是提取出来的文字而不是文件本身，页面上有标注；每天 5 页免费，超了的话 9 美元买 30 天 1500 页，一次性付款不续费。二是它没做 PWA，页面本身还是要联网才打得开。 几个可以直接试的： 压缩图片 PDF 转 JPG 按行拆 Excel（120 行拆成三份，每份都带表头）

projects.title: 【开源自荐】geo-sleuth：没有文字的照片，AI 也能找出拍摄地点
projects.author: Oldcircle

github.name: Oldcircle/geo-sleuth
github.description: An agent skill that finds where a photo was taken — OpenStreetMap geometry, elevation skylines, satellite imagery and street view — and shows its work. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and GitHub Copilot.

projects.summary: （MIT） geo-sleuth 是一个 Agent Skill。把一张照片交给 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 这类 agent，说一句「这张照片是在哪拍的」，它会给出拍摄机位、镜头朝向和一张卫星证据图。 它和让大模型直接看图猜地点不一样：模型只负责读画面、提线索，搜索和排序交给二十个 Python 脚本，用 OpenStreetMap 几何、高程数据、卫星图和街景去比对。所以画面里没有招牌、车牌、地标，也能往下查。 README 里的案例：一张抹掉 EXIF 的手机照片，稻田边一个白色烤炉，远处一条高架，右边一座山，没有一个字。 从 OpenStreetMap 取出区域内 27,335 段铁路桥，用高程算地平线，筛到 171 处 渲染 14,372 个候选机位的山脊线和照片比对，剩 3 个 把照片里 17 根桥墩当尺子，最后定到广东清远的一个点，误差约 2 米，全程约 72 分钟 安装： bash npx skills add Oldcircle/geo-sleuth

projects.title: 【开源自荐】skillsgist：部署在自己 Cloudflare 账号上的私有 Agent Skills 仓库，用官方 npx skills 一条命令安装
projects.author: Qsnh

github.name: Qsnh/skillsgist
github.description: A private Agent Skills registry you self-host on Cloudflare. Manage skills in the browser, install them with the stock npx skills add.

projects.summary: （MIT） skillsgist 是一个私有的 Agent Skills 仓库，部署在你自己的 Cloudflare 账号上。技能在网页上上传和管理，团队成员用官方的 npx skills add 一条命令，就能把技能装进 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等 Agent。 做它的原因：团队内部沉淀的技能，比如代码评审清单、发版流程、内部规范，往往不适合发到公开的技能仓库，但大家又希望像安装公开技能一样一条命令装好。skillsgist 直接实现了 skills.sh 的发现协议（/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json），所以不需要自定义 CLI、插件或 fork。 几个可能有用的细节： 默认私有，每个技能单独决定要不要公开；公开的技能不需要密钥就能安装 私有安装用个人的 install key，这个 key 只能安装，不能登录、发布或删除，可以一键轮换 可以上传 .zip、.tar.gz 或单个 SKILL.md，也可以直接在网页上改 SKILL.md 版本不可变、按数字递增，旧版本都能查看和下载；制品按内容摘要寻址，CLI 下载时会校验 有幂等的发布 API，可以在 CI 里每次 push 都自动发布 整个服务就是一个 Worker、一个 D1 数据库和一个 R2 存储桶，默认限制在 Workers 免费套餐以内 README 里有 Deploy to Cloudflare 按钮，可以一键部署；也可以用 Wrangler 手动部署 安装命令长这样： bash npx skills add 截图： 一句话简介（供周刊参考）：一个自托管的私有 Agent Skills 仓库，部署在 Cloudflare 上，在网页上管理技能，用官方的 npx skills add 命令安装。 欢迎试用和提 issue。

projects.summary: （MIT） SyncClipboard 官方服务端的 Cloudflare Workers 复刻实现（TypeScript + D1 + R2 + Durable Objects）。官方客户端（Windows / macOS / Android，v3.1.1 及以上）零改动，把服务器地址指向部署好的 Worker 就能用：剪贴板实时同步（SignalR WebSocket 长连接）、WebDAV 兼容端点、历史记录跨设备同步。 做它的原因：官方服务端要自备 VPS / Docker / 进程守护，而这个实现把服务端搬到 Cloudflare 边缘——无服务器、免运维、按量计费，个人用量基本落在免费额度内（一台客户端全天在线约 1.7 万次请求/天，免费额度 10 万次/天）。 比官方多出来的： 内置 Web 历史管理界面：浏览 / 搜索 / 筛选 / 排序历史记录，收藏、置顶、批量操作、文本与图片预览、复制下载；回收站（删除的记录连同图片/文件数据保留 30 天，可一键恢复）；在线调整保留策略，不用重新部署。 部署两条路：命令行（wrangler），或 GitHub Actions（Fork 后配几个 Secret，推 master 自动建资源并部署）。 与官方服务端的行为差异（先说清楚，避免踩坑）： 单次上传默认上限 48 MiB（可调到 64 MiB），超出返回 413； 文件夹 zip 解压总量 64 MiB、条目 1000、单条目 24 MiB； 历史清理每 20 分钟一轮； 访问不存在的地址且未带凭据时返回 401，并计入失败限速。 这些限制来自 Cloudflare 免费档的约束（单请求 100 MiB、isolate 内存 128 MiB）；客户端默认单文件 20 MB，正常使用大多碰不到。 工程上：协议行为逐条对照官方源码实现，并与官方发布件做过 A/B 实测；22 个测试套件；所有有意偏离都登记在 docs/protocol.md 的差异表里。 独立的社区实现，与官方项目无关联、未获官方背书；协议行为与哈希算法移植自官方（MIT，版权声明已保留在 LICENSE 中）。

projects.title: Show HN: Run Linux kernel drivers in userspace on Neptune OS, NT-like OS on seL4
projects.author: cl91
projects.summary: For the past ten years I have been working on a side project which I have taken to call Neptune OS [1], named after the ill-fated Microsoft Windows codename. Neptune OS is a Windows NT-like operating system built on the seL4 microkernel. The project has reached a point where it can run non-trivial, unmodified or minimally modified Windows or Linux kernel drivers as native (ie. NOT in a VM), unprivileged userspace processes on seL4. For instance, here [2] is amdgpu and i915 (from the Linux kernel DRM subsystem) successfully performing mode-setting on Haswell+Radeon RX560 for hotplugged monitors. The linked youtube channel has more demos for storage, networking, and power management drivers. Why I started working on this and why I think it is interesting: If you were familiar with early Windows NT development history, you'd probably know that NT was (allegedly) supposed to be a microkernel OS, where system services exist as user-mode servers sitting on top of a Mach-style port-based IPC. Unfortunately the late 1980s' computing technology prevented Microsoft from realizing this vision, and as a result the Windows we see today has everything dumped into kernel space (they even put an HTTP server in kernel mode!), leading to stability and security issues. This unrealized potential of the NT architecture never sat right to me, so when the seL4 microkernel was open-sourced back in 2014, I immediately thought, well perhaps one could rewrite NT as a personality on top of seL4. This "re-imagined" NT on seL4 will have the NT system call services implemented as a userspace process that talks to client processes via the high performance, formally verified seL4 IPC. Device drivers will then also run in isolated, unprivileged user processes, the crash of which will not lead to a BSOD-inducing full system crash. Another feature of the NT architecture I find very interesting is its so-called Environment Subsystems. These sit on top of the NT native system call services and expose them as more friendly user-facing APIs, such as Win32 and POSIX. I always thought it was a real shame that Microsoft has essentially given up on this idea and today's Windows is Win32-only (WSL1 being a much-needed redemption, but was then mercilessly dropped). With this seL4 rewrite of NT, I thought I could take this idea one step further and expand these environment subsystems to include device drivers, as they now run in userspace where they should have belonged. The result is the Linux Driver Subsystem in the latest v0.4 release of the project. In addition to native Windows drivers (which now run in userspace), this subsystem allows unmodified (or very minimally modified) Linux kernel drivers to run as native user processes on seL4. Note these are not virtual machines --- they are just regular, unprivileged processes. More technical details can be found in the mailing list announcement [3], but the basic idea is to add a new arch port to the Linux kernel similar to that of UML and the lkl (Linux-kernel-as-a-library) project. When compiled for this architecture, a reduced Linux kernel binary will essentially run as a regular program, requesting resources from the underlying host OS via the seL4 IPC. This binary communicates with the host OS via a carefully defined interface, which is in fact not tied to seL4 specifically, meaning our work can potentially be reused for other NT-like OSes (including Windows itself), or even other non NT-like OSes (with some more effort). Anyway, if you have read this far, I hope you find this project interesting. What do you think? What kind of applications do you think Neptune OS can potentially have? Do you think the project has sufficient industrial relevance to go beyond a hobby operating system? Let me know in the comments below. [1] https://github.com/cl91/NeptuneOS [2] https://youtu.be/BJIrUZIGgBc [3] https://lists.sel4.systems/hyperkitty/list/devel@sel4.system...

projects.summary: 将 GeminiCLI 与 Antigravity 转换为兼容 OpenAI、Claude 和 Gemini 标准格式的自托管 API 网关。 基于上游开源项目二次开发，专注于生产与个人开发场景下的多账号池轮询调度、429 配额耗尽模型自动降级、API Key 权限分发以及 Token/费用统计监控。 为什么做这个项目？ 在使用各类客户端工具（如 Cherry Studio、NextChat、Cursor、各类 Agent 框架等）对接 Gemini 或 Antigravity 时，经常会遇到几个痛点： 1. 单账号配额易被限流：高频并发或重度使用容易触发 429 配额限制，单一模型一旦耗尽便导致调用链路全面中断。 2. 缺乏多凭证统一管理：手头有多个凭证时，手动切换繁琐，无法自动探测凭证失效（如 403 封禁）或健康状况。 3. 对外分发与用量失控：想要将接口分享给团队成员或部署到家庭服务器时，缺少独立的 API Key 权限控制与清晰的 Token 用量/费用账本。 因此本项目在转 API 的基础能力之上，重点补充了企业级/团队级网关所需的凭证健康生命周期管理与降级冗余机制。 核心特性 模型配额耗尽自动降级链：配置 ANTIGRAVITYMODELFALLBACKCHAIN 后，当高阶模型遇到明确的配额耗尽型 429 时，网关会自动平滑降级至备选模型（如 Flash / Tiered 版本），保障长任务或 Agent 链路不被阻断。 多账号凭证池与健康守护：支持多账号轮询调度、403 异常复核隔离、账号健康检查以及 RT / OAuth 一键登录管理。 完整的 API Key 与权限控制：支持签发独立 API Key，可单独设置权限范围、速率限制以及过期策略。 Token 用量与费用统计：内置可视化 Web 控制台，实时展示请求吞吐量、各模型 Token 消耗走势与费用账本。 高可用存储架构：以 SQLite 作为核心持久化主账本，可选配合 Redis 镜像加速计费统计与看板查询，支持非流响应大缓冲区与流式守护。 开箱即用：提供多架构 Docker 镜像（支持 amd64 / arm64），一条命令即可完成部署。 快速部署 使用 Docker 快速启动： bash docker run -d \ name gcli2api \ network host \ e APIPASSWORD=yourapipassword \ e PANELPASSWORD=yourpanelpassword \ e PORT=7861 \ v "$(pwd)/data/creds:/app/creds" \ ghcr.io/wzh0718/gcl2api-plus:latest 启动后访问 即可进入管理控制面板配置账号与模型降级链。 界面截图 | API Key 签发与权限管理 | 统计监控与费用账本 | | :---: | :---: | | | | | 账号与凭证管理 | 详细 Token 统计分布 | | :---: | :---: | | | |

projects.author: tim_tairov
projects.summary: Hi HN! I made Tim’s Markdown Reader because I wanted a free, open-source app just for reading Markdown. I spend a lot of time working with AI coding agents, and sometimes I just want to open the files they produce and read them without opening an editor. It’s written in Swift and works entirely offline, including Mermaid diagrams. It has no accounts, telemetry or network requests. You can click links to other Markdown files and open them in the same window, with back and forward buttons. It also has search, automatic reload when a file changes, light and dark modes, adjustable fonts and text size, and centred or full-width layouts. It started as something I needed myself, but I’ve since spent quite a bit of time refining it for public release. I wanted to keep it fast and minimal while making it feel like a proper Mac app, with attention to small details. It’s MIT licensed, and the app is Developer ID-signed and notarized by Apple. Requires Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later (tested on macOS 26 and 27). This is my first public open-source release. Would be good to hear what you guys think!

Some alignment properties present in flex are missing from grid. - Note: Table only supports `table-layout: auto`, not fixed * Positioning Schemes: static, relative, absolute, sticky, fixed * Floating and cleared elements * CSS Combinators: Child, Descendant, Next-Sibling, Subsequent-Sibling * CSS Selectors: ID, type, class, attribute * CSS Pseudo-Classes/Elements: :hover, :link, :focus, :focus-within, :focus-visible, :has, :is, :not, :where, :first-child, :last-child, :only-child, :nth-child, :first-of-type, :last-of-type, :only-of-type, ::before, ::after * CSS Functions: calc (and related functions), var * CSS layers (the `@layer` at-rules) * Media Queries: screen type, min/max-width/height media features * Text selection, text fields, GET/POST forms, cycle focus via tab button, and fragment navigation * (Linux) Support for A11Y via a fork of AccessKit (Experimental, enable with `-a11y accesskit`). projects.summary: 几乎每一个大数据团队都会需要一个类似OneService的服务。这类服务一般要求如下： 统一标准与安全管控：提供统一的接口标准，并通过 API 申请、鉴权、限流、白名单等手段，保障数据安全，避免敏感数据直接暴露给应用 全生命周期管理：支持从 API 的创建、测试、发布到调用的全流程管理，并实现开发态与生产态的环境隔离。 运维监控与告警：可以监控 API 的调用量、异常情况，并支持配置超时、失败、限流等告警（如企业IM、邮件、短信），方便运维人员及时发现问题 这类项目是必须要做的，但其实做到后面都是大相径庭的，为了给大家节省力气，容我向大家介绍一下主角——DataPoly。 DataPoly（ 是个分布式、有高可用机制的OneService应用，基于SQLRest遵循BSD协议进行了二次开发。进行二次开发的主要原因如下： 1. 项目扩展点不足。比如一个SQL在上线前，我们要看其执行计划，是不是符合我们的期待。但这个不应该写在开源项目里，哪怕写在自己的项目里，这样后面去合并上游也会很麻烦。 2. 在面对较为灵活的场景，有比直接写Grovvy脚本更好的方案。Grovvy还是相关还是面向开发者，对数仓同学并不友好。 3. 权限管控能力较为基础，没有多角色的划分。 在目前的v1.9.x实现中，已经支持了部分重要扩展点，并支持Spring or SPI的方式来向应用注入扩展。整体功能仍在丰富中。原相关功能展示： 在接下来的2个月内，我将继续围绕着上述三个核心原因进行迭代，同时还会考虑系统集成便利度与界面交互的相关改进。大家遇到任何问题也可以开issue，觉得好用也可以给项目点个star，鼓励我持续迭代它。

projects.author: gura105

github.name: gura105/operational-ontology
github.description: A minimal, readable reference implementation of the Operational Ontology pattern. Palantir Foundry is one implementation; this is the concept, minimized.

projects.summary: 简体中文 README： Palantir 的 Ontology 在中文圈讨论很多，但"它到底是什么"很难落到代码上。这个项目把其中的模式抽出来，用一份小型 TypeScript 参考实现给出可运行的定义。一句话：语义层让你"读"业务，Operational Ontology 让你"运行"业务。 具体是四条性质同时成立： 对象和链接：在其他系统拥有的数据之上建立共享的业务模型 写入只经过命名的 Action：规则在 Action 内检查（例如已发货的订单不能取消），违反时返回机器可读的拒绝码 每次尝试都进审计日志，被拒绝的也一样 被接受的变更写回到数据的权威来源系统（write-back） 同一份模型可以直接生成 MCP 工具。AI Agent 调用 cancelorder 时收到的拒绝码和人类操作一样，业务规则不需要写在提示词里。 它适合什么场景？ 我们把它叫做"数据驱动的业务运营"：出了一件事，要把分散在几个系统里的数据串起来，找出该对谁、对什么采取行动，再把行动本身记录下来。仓库里有三个示例： 工厂：某台设备被发现异常。经过它的是哪些批次？这些批次发给了哪些客户？找出来之后，创建客户联系或复检任务，并把证据（设备、批次、发货记录）挂在任务上 医院：一位患者要入院。哪张病床、哪位护士同时满足要求？记录临时分配，Action 会在执行时复核，不会把已确定的资源分配给第二个人 金融：几个被标记的账户之间有没有共同的收款方？记录调查案件，并把作为证据的转账一并记下 三个示例都是虚构数据，pnpm factory / hospital / finance 可以直接跑。共同点是：先在对象和链接上"查案"，再通过 Action 落地，找到候选并不等于业务状态已经改变。 订单主线的演示是 pnpm 两套字段和状态编码都不同的遗留订单系统整合成一个模型，然后读取、写入、拒绝、写回。 MIT 协议。这是学习用的参考实现，不是框架。 我是作者。欢迎提反例和问题，尤其欢迎"这条性质在我们的系统里不成立"这类意见。

projects.title: Show HN: Relay – a self-hosted LLM gateway with smart routing and request pacing
projects.author: pavelmelnichuk
projects.summary: Hi, I’m Pavel. I’ve been building Relay, a self-hostable AI gateway. The main thing I wanted to solve was smart routing without turning the gateway itself into a bottleneck. Relay can classify an incoming request, decide what kind of model capabilities the request needs, then route it across your configured providers while also accounting for limits and available capacity. It ships with routing classification models I’ve trained specifically for this problem, with the option of swapping that piece for Laya or other System One models. This started when I was trying to string together several providers’ free tiers. I kept hitting rate limits at different intervals, which broke some of my agent clients. Some agents were also getting greedy with shared resources, so I needed a way to manage how they used the available capacity. That led to Relay’s queue-first approach. Sometimes it’s better to wait a second or two for your preferred model than immediately fall back to another one. Relay queues and paces requests against configured provider limits, aiming to make use of available capacity without repeatedly hitting rate-limit errors or needlessly falling back to worse models. Relay’s classification model also looks for signals that a request needs specific capabilities, such as coding or more complex reasoning, while classifying the request’s main intent before routing anything. One thing I’ve obsessed over is keeping that decision layer cheap. Relay’s built-in classifier runs in the single digit millisecond range. It has a deliberately narrow job: classifying LLM requests and helping decide where to send them. It probably won’t be playing DOOM, but that’s a trade off I’m happy with for a routing layer. In the routing tests I've run so far, the built-in classifier is considerably faster than Laya while producing broadly similar routing decisions. Working on getting Jev up and running, and will report back to see how that stacks up as well. The community version is available now, with a public repo, a built-in dashboard, and a local classifier. It’s written in Go, and you can run it with npx @anchorshell/relay or build it from source. The gateway itself is lightweight; it also ships with small classification models you can use locally. There’s also a hosted version with a free tier if you don’t want to run it yourself. It offers our more capable classification models, along with team features, and separate limits for individual agents.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Prism：跨平台社交内容分析框架，按收藏率而非点赞排序
projects.author: millennialdreamer

github.name: millennialdreamer/prism
github.description: Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili and Kuaishou analytics — one unified schema, MediaCrawler-compatible. Engagement quant, sentiment and virality forecast. Ranks by save-rate, not likes.

projects.summary: 向周刊自荐一个开源项目：Prism。 做内容研究的时候会遇到一个尴尬：开源世界的采集器已经很成熟了，但抓回来之后呢？小红书的字段和 B 站的对不上，抖音和快手又各是一套，想回答「哪类内容更值得做」这种问题，每换一个平台就得重写一遍分析代码。 Prism 做的是采集器之上那一层：把各平台的原始帖子归一到同一套五张表（博主 / 笔记 / 指标 / 文本 / 分析结果），同一份分析代码跨平台直接复用，新增一个平台只需要写一个 adapter，不用动分析层。目前内置小红书、B 站、抖音、快手四个适配器。 它有一个和同类工具不太一样的判断：按收藏率排序，而不是点赞数。 点赞只表示「不错」，收藏才表示「我还会回来看」。项目自带的演示数据里，收藏率榜单前排全是攻略类内容；同一批数据改按点赞排，出来的是猫和日落，两份完全不同的榜单。 目前可以： 定量分析：分布、集中度、图文与视频对比、收藏率排名 情感分析：走本地 LLM，也可以配置任意 OpenAI 兼容端点 时序与预测：线性回归回测 数据自带：内置 adapter、MediaCrawler 导出、或任意自定义来源都行，schema 才是约定 合规默认开启：用户 ID 加盐 HMAC 哈希、敏感字段丢弃、内置速率限制 技术上是纯 Python + SQLite，没有额外的中间件，可以完全私有化部署。字段映射外置在 yml 里，平台改版时只改配置不动代码。 装完想立刻看到效果的话，有一个离线 demo，不用配 cookies 也不用联网： bash pip install -e ".[forecast]" prism demo 一秒后输出： ① Collect-rate ranking (save/like — Prism's core signal): 2.38 save 1520 / like 640 Every visa document I needed, in order 1.82 save 1655 / like 910 Reading a rental contract line by line 1.82 save 1490 / like 820 How to pick a rice cooker without overpaying ② By content type (avg saves): image n=9 avgsave=1748 video n=11 avgsave=693 ③ Save distribution: n=20 median=940 p90=1980 max=2610 ④ Save concentration: HHI=657 top3-share=0.284 比较适合想自己掌控数据、而不是租一个黑盒面板的技术型运营、独立开发者和中小数据团队。项目还在持续完善，特别希望听到真实使用中遇到的问题，尤其是新增其他平台 adapter 的需求。

projects.author: rafnixg
projects.summary: I build a Mini-Runbot, an open source PoC for creating ephemeral enviroments for Odoo from a Git commit. This is a mini implementation of the real workflow used by Odoo in Odoo-Runbot and the workflow using in the platform Odoo.sh This workdflow take a testing branch and prepare a database, install modules, start Odoo instance, export a port, check that everything works and cleaning everything up afterward. A build can: - resolve a Git branch or tag - prepare an isolated checkout - install selected Odoo modules - run Odoo test - start Odoo instance - test an HTTP healtcheck - expose a temporary preview - destoy the environment when it is no longer needed The project is written mainly in Python, using FastAPI, Typer and Codex. It is intentionally a small and single-host PoC, thats not a replacement for Odoo official runbot, I wanted to explore a lightweight preview environment platform. The applications is available on PyPI: pipx install mini-runbot Docs: https://rafnixg.github.io/odoo-platform-ephemeral-environmen... Source: https://github.com/rafnixg/odoo-platform-ephemeral-environme... PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/mini-runbot/ The next areas I am exploring are GitHub Pull Request integration, workers and job scheduling, observability, concurrency, and eventually distributed execution. I would especially appreciate feedback from people working with Python, Odoo, CI/CD, or Platform Engineering on the architecture and isolation model.

projects.title: Cronhq
projects.summary: Cron jobs fail in silence. Two servers run the same crontab and your billing job fires twice. A job dies and nobody notices for weeks. Cronhq is a scheduler built around one guarantee: exactly-once execution, enforced by Postgres locks — not best-effort. Around it: retries with backoff, HMAC-signed webhooks, heartbeat monitors for jobs we don't run, and alerts that fire once on failure and once on recovery. Rust on Postgres. MIT-licensed, self-hostable, same image we run. Free tier: 5 jobs.
projects.summaryZh: 基于 Postgres 锁保证精确一次执行的定时任务调度器，提供重试退避、HMAC 签名 Webhook、心跳监控及失败与恢复告警，Rust 编写，可自托管。

projects.title: Show HN: Bridgeflare – Replace Docker with Cloudflare
projects.author: hypendev
projects.summary: Hey HN, I have way too many sideprojects so docker images have been eating up most of my RAM, but besides "deploy them" there isn't much I can do during development to cut it down. So I build Bridgeflare - a drop-in docker replacement that serves the containers on Cloudflare then tunnels them back to you as localhost. It basically a small daemon that uses the Docker API, so you can just keep using normal docker CLI commands and bridgeflare will do the work underneath: - Build your image - Deploy to CF containers - Setup tunneling across services - Tunnel them back safely to your machine so you see them as `localhost` - Small MacOS menu bar to monitor the running containers for ease of use In a way, it's like the reverse of CF's recently released quick tunnels. As always, it is early and there are some limits: - Images need to be amd64 based (CF containers limits) - No docker exec - No post-lifecycle persistence

projects.title: [开源推荐] Mirage：能在账号被封前发出预警的爬虫行为加固工具
projects.author: millennialdreamer

github.name: millennialdreamer/mirage
github.description: Anti-detection hardening + soft-ban radar for MediaCrawler — Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, Bilibili, Weibo, Zhihu, Tieba. Know when you're being throttled, before you're banned.

projects.summary: 市面上的反检测工具都在帮你「看起来像人」，但没有一个会告诉你「什么时候已经不管用了」。平台很少直接封号，而是先悄悄降权：验证码变多、返回体变薄、延迟上升、成功率下滑——等你看到硬性的 403，代理费已经烧在垃圾数据上好几天了。Mirage 做两件事：一条命令给已有爬虫打上五层行为补丁（幂等、自动备份、可一键还原），以及一个读五个先行指标的软封禁雷达，在封禁真正落地前告警。核心加固零第三方依赖。仅供学习研究，非商业许可。 亮点 1. 「软封禁雷达」是这个项目真正的差异点。 反检测浏览器只看得到指纹，代理商只看得到 IP，打码平台只看得到验证码——只有 Mirage 站在同时能看见「你注入了什么」「你发了什么」「平台回了什么」的那个位置上，所以它能做趋势判断，而它们做不了。 2. 它不吹牛，这点很难得。 样本不够时它会直说。实际跑一下的输出长这样： Level: insufficient data Risk score: 0/100 Samples: 0 Advice: Only 0 observation(s) (need >= 12). Too few to mean anything — keep going normally and do not draw conclusions from this. ⚠ This is a heuristic trend judgment, not an exact determination; it does not replace risk-control circuit breaker — both are needed. 需要 12 个以上观测才给结论，并且明确写「这是启发式趋势判断，不是精确判定，不能替代风控熔断」。见过太多工具在没数据的时候硬给一个分数唬人。 3. 改别人的代码但不留烂摊子。 --dry-run 先看会改什么、一个字节都不写；正式执行时每个动到的文件先备份；--revert 从备份完整还原；跑两次零 diff（幂等）。还能装 git hook，上游 MediaCrawler 更新覆盖掉补丁时提醒你。 4. 核心零第三方依赖，clone 下来就能跑，Python 3.9+。 5. 对学习者的价值：可以看到反检测这件事的完整技术面——时序抖动为什么要用对数正态而不是固定间隔、贝塞尔曲线鼠标轨迹、指纹自洽性校验（伪造的设备参数之间会不会互相矛盾），以及 CDP Runtime.enable 这类注入脚本够不到的泄漏层该怎么处理。 需要说清楚的两点：项目采用非商业研究许可，不是 OSI 标准开源协议；仓库内含一个互动引擎（点赞/关注/收藏/评论），默认 dryrun=True 且有每日配额上限，文档反复强调只用小号、遇验证码即停。作者在 README 里明确写了平台服务条款通常禁止自动化访问，后果自负。

projects.title: [开源]「Flotilla v1.0.0：让 AI 一次管理所有服务器，但每一步都过人审批」
projects.author: MuskZhou
projects.summary: > 本人文笔不佳，写不出想表达的意思，以下内容有部分是 ai 代笔后我再进行更改，或者让 ai 帮我调整更美观的格式，提前抱歉 > 如果各位对于本项目有任何的建议或者想法，可以随时私信我或者提 issue ，第一次写这种项目，请各位多多包容 我之前在自己做梯子的时候，老是需要在好几个 ssh 里面跳来跳去，有时候还会输入指令给错的服务器，每次让 ai 做小改动，都要给他说每台服务器的基本情况。但是现在找到的 mcp 服务又大多是单台服务器，不是跨服务器的。 所以我就写了 Flotilla 这个项目：一个把整个服务器舰队当成一个整体来管理的 MCP Server 。 ![image]( https://mac-dropbox.s3.bitiful.net/0-banner.png?no-wait=on) ### 我想先讲讲在我实际使用中它解决了我的什么问题 1. 只需要和 agent 说一句话，他就会自动获取我所有服务器的状态，他们之间的联系 2. 我让 ai 帮我做一个线路+落地的节点，全部不需要我在两台服务器操作，它自动在两台服务器执行需要的命令 3. 让他获取我们所有服务的 nginx 状态和情况，可以直接做出一个网络拓扑图 ![image]( https://mac-dropbox.s3.bitiful.net/3-exec-picker.png?no-wait=on) ### 安装与运行模式 做 Flotilla 的初衷就是因为我不想在多台服务器之间跳来跳去——所以安装被压缩到一句命令： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/paipaiio/flotilla-mcp/main/deploy/bootstrap.sh -o bootstrap.sh bash bootstrap.sh ``` 脚本自动识别系统环境（有 Docker 用 Docker ，有 Node ≥ 20 用 Node ，都没有就自动装 Docker ），然后引导入网第一台机器、生成 token 、拉起服务——空白服务器到上线约 10 分钟。重复执行是安全的：续走未完成的部分，不重复建容器/服务。 #### 模式一：本地运行 装在自己的 MacBook 或者工作机上，本地以 stdio 暴露 MCP ，接进 Claude Code 、Cursor 等 harness： ```bash claude mcp add --transport stdio flotilla -- flotilla-mcp ``` 私钥和配置只存在你自己的机器上，信任边界最清晰；和 Claude Code 本地体验无缝——审批弹窗、交互式确认全可用。 #### 模式二：网站模式（团队 / 云端 agent ） 部署到一台服务器，把整个舰队暴露为一个带 token 鉴权的 HTTPS MCP 端点。两个典型接法： - **网站连接器**：Grok 等平台的自定义 MCP 连接器，直接填 URL + token - **聚合服务**：Cloudflare 这类 MCP 聚合/代理服务背后挂它 ```bash bash bootstrap.sh # 同一脚本；装完把 127.0.0.1:PORT 反代到 Caddy/nginx （模板见 deploy/） ``` fleet 随即成为 `https://mcp.example.com/mcp`。团队新机器入网只需一行 `join.sh --token `，人和 agent 走同一个入口，同一套策略与审计。 附图： ![image]( https://mac-dropbox.s3.bitiful.net/2-dashboard.png?no-wait=on) ![image]( https://mac-dropbox.s3.bitiful.net/4-enroll.png?no-wait=on) ![image]( https://mac-dropbox.s3.bitiful.net/3-exec-rolling.png?no-wait=on)

github.description: 供应链工具箱（Supply Chain Toolkit）| 面向采购、PMC 与库存计划员的桌面级离线库存决策工具。

projects.summary: 一款面向实体制造、工贸与零售企业的纯离线桌面级库存决策工具。 用户导入日常的 Excel/CSV 表格，即可在本地完成需求预测、多物料订货量全局运筹求解、呆滞缺货诊断与库存体检。无需配置数据库，不用联网，零 IT 部署成本。 为什么做它？ 中小企业的库存管理常年处于两难：专业 ERP/APS 动辄几十万且实施沉重；日常使用巨型 Excel 动辄卡死闪退，算不准上千物料在总资金预算下的平衡。同时，由于单件采购价格与客户需求属于核心商业机密，企业往往抗拒上传云端 SaaS。 为此，我们用 Tauri + Rust 打造了这款完全运行在本地的高性能小工具。 技术亮点 Tauri v2 + Rust：轻量跨平台原生体验（支持 macOS Apple 芯片 / Win 10/11），运筹算法并行高速求解。 100% 离线与隐私保护：嵌入式 SQLite 本地自闭环，断网完全可用，数据不出个人电脑。 实用业务约束对齐：直接对齐供应商最低订货量 (MOQ) 与最小包装量 (MPQ) 物理约束，算出的建议清单可直接导回 ERP 执行。 费用属性：完全免费、无需注册登录，安装即用。 界面截图

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Data Asset Portal：面向数仓团队的轻量数据资产目录
projects.author: 0verme

github.name: 0verme/data-asset-portal-community
github.description: 数据资产管理门户，面向数据仓库各层。支持数据表的浏览、新增、编辑、删除及字段/DDL 管理，React + Vite 前端 + Fastapi后端，支持内网离线部署。A lightweight metadata management portal for data warehouses: browse table assets, trace field/table mappings, and maintain roots, indicators, and downstream metadata.

projects.summary: 大家好，我是 Data Asset Portal 的作者，想向周刊自荐这个开源项目。 做数据仓库时，经常需要确认：某个字段是什么意思、一个指标来自哪张表、上下游之间有哪些映射关系。这些信息可能分散在 Excel、建表语句和不同的文档里，查找和交接都比较费事。 Data Asset Portal 尝试把这些信息整理成一个可以搜索、浏览和维护的中文目录，主要面向中小型数仓团队。 目前可以： 搜索数据表、字段、指标、报表和 API 资产，查看字段说明与指标口径。 维护字段映射，查看已导入的上下游血缘关系。 通过 HTTP API 导入外部系统整理好的元数据，也可以在页面中维护资产信息。 项目采用 React + FastAPI，运行时不依赖独立搜索引擎或消息队列，可以部署在内网单机环境。仓库提供基于 SQLite 和虚构零售数据的一键 Demo，方便先体验完整的前后端流程。 当前比较适合已经有元数据整理或采集程序、希望补一个统一查询入口的团队。数据库采集和血缘解析由外部工具完成，门户负责接收、管理和展示这些信息。 项目还在持续完善，欢迎做数仓、数据开发和 BI 的朋友试用，尤其希望听到真实接入和日常查找过程中遇到的问题。

projects.title: Show HN: Sigabrt.dev – cronjob monitor with an SSH TUI
projects.summary: Hello HN. I built this mostly to monitor the things I host myself. I know it's nothing too exciting. Anyway, the TL;DR is: Create an endpoint, and if your script/cronjob fails to regularly ping it, you get notified (by email or ntfy). E.g.: 0 * * * * ./script.sh && curl -fsS https://sigabrt.dev/pulse/<id>/beat It also has an SSH TUI which is currently experimental and read-only, mostly because I'm not sure whether it is actually useful or just a gimmick :): ssh sigabrt.dev To use it, simply add your SSH public key in your account settings. Yes, there are services like this already, and this is minimalistic by comparison. Feedback is welcome.

projects.title: Show HN: I compiled FreeRDP into a Flutter app so my phone can do RDP and SSH
projects.author: neil_thomas
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm the developer. XConnect is an SSH/SFTP client for iOS and Android that also has a real RDP client built in, so one app covers my Linux and Windows machines when I'm away from my desk. No account needed: tap "Continue Offline" and everything stays on the phone. I built it because fixing things from my phone meant switching between an SSH app, a file app and Microsoft's RDP app, and on a small screen the switching was the worst part. What it does: - SSH and Telnet, with a key row for phone keyboards (Esc, Tab, arrows, sticky Ctrl/Alt, one-tap Ctrl-C/D/L/Z) and multiple sessions. - RDP (iOS for now). FreeRDP 3 is compiled into the app, so the phone speaks RDP directly, with no gateway or relay. Trackpad or direct-touch mode, pinch to zoom, two-finger right-click and scroll. Hardware keyboards are forwarded by scancode. - SFTP, jump hosts (ProxyJump-style, for both SSH and SFTP), and 14 built-in scripts you can run on a server with one tap. - An optional AI agent with your own API key (OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Anthropic, or Ollama on your LAN). It runs commands on the host and asks before anything that looks destructive. It does nothing until you configure it. Some technical details: the native RDP core sends Dart one event per frame (connected / bitmap / resize / error / disconnected), in the same binary format my desktop app's RDP helper uses. Dart applies the updates to an RGBA framebuffer and paints it with decodeImageFromPixels. SSH is dartssh2 and the terminal is xterm.dart. Scripts run as heredocs, because my first version joined the lines with "; " and put the whole script behind the shebang comment. Credentials: passwords and private keys are stored in the iOS Keychain / Android Keystore. Sync is optional. Records are encrypted on the device with AES-256-GCM before upload, with a key derived from your account password (PBKDF2, then scrypt per record). To be upfront: login currently sends that password to the server over TLS, so this is not zero-knowledge yet. [Switching login to a separately derived auth hash is next on my list.] The app is closed source. I know that's a hard sell for something that holds SSH keys, so ask me anything about how credentials are handled. Not there yet: RDP on Android, port forwarding on mobile (the desktop app has it), passphrase-protected keys, keyboard-interactive 2FA, and mosh. Pricing: SSH, Telnet, SFTP, scripts and one jump host are free. Pro ($8/month, $68/year, or $88 one-time) adds RDP, the AI agent, sync and unlimited jump hosts. The same account also works in the desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux. iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/xconnect-ssh-rdp-client/id6810... I'd love feedback, especially from people who manage servers from their phone. What's missing?

projects.title: Show HN: vNetMap – A zero-knowledge E2E encrypted network topology mapper
projects.author: vnetmap
projects.summary: I built this because I was tired of manually maintaining Excel sheets and Visio diagrams for my homelab documentation. The core idea is automated discovery via Nmap, but without sending plaintext network data to a hosted backend. It uses strict client-side Zero-Knowledge End-to-End Encryption. The Architecture: The Scanner: A lightweight Python agent running locally in a Docker container. It uses Nmap to scan the local subnet. The Encryption: The payload is encrypted locally before it ever leaves the network. The backend (FastAPI/PostgreSQL) only receives and stores encrypted blobs. The Frontend: Decryption happens entirely client-side in the browser (Angular), rendering the topology using vis-network. Technical Hurdles & Limitations I'm currently facing: Hostname Discovery is a nightmare: Across different vendors, devices handle broadcast differently (mDNS, NetBIOS, pure DNS). The agent catches what it can, but often falls back to raw IPs because reliable local resolution is incredibly inconsistent. Physical Connections: While Nmap easily discovers the devices and open ports on the subnet, mapping the exact physical connections (which switch port goes where, device types, Wi-Fi details) still requires manual linking in the UI. Links: Live App: https://app.vnetmap.com GitHub (Docs & Agent Setup): https://github.com/vNetMap/vnetmap-issues I'm curious to hear how you handle automated discovery in your homelabs, especially regarding the hostname resolution issue, or if you spot any flaws in this E2E approach.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】sh.cd：一行命令给服务器做体检，硬件、IP 质量、三网回程一次测完（推荐）
projects.author: gentpan

github.name: CleanIP/sh.cd
github.description: 服务器全面体检: 硬件与性能、IP 质量、网络质量, 一行命令跑完 · One-line server check-up by CleanIP

projects.summary: 背景 买了 VPS 之后要测的东西很零碎：硬件跑分一个脚本，IP 纯净度一个网站，三网延迟和回程线路又是另外几个脚本，跑完还得自己截图拼到一起发论坛。我想要一条命令全测完，结果能直接甩个链接出去。 它是什么 一个服务器体检脚本，只依赖 bash 和 curl，本身不装任何软件（CPU、硬盘跑分需要 sysbench 和 fio，开始前问一次）。 硬件与性能：虚拟化类型、CPU / 内存 / 硬盘跑分；独立服务器还能读硬盘 SMART、内存条规格与温度，可选跑 Geekbench 6 IP 质量：纯净度与风险评分、多源检测、9 项流媒体与 AI 解锁、25 端口与 12 家邮箱握手、DNS 出口 网络质量：NAT 类型（NAT1–4）、BGP、31 省三网延迟加 223 个市级节点、31 省 × 三网的回程线路识别（CN2 GIA / 9929 / CMIN2 等，含大包回程、教育网回程与 IPv6）、国内外带宽测速、六大洲 36 个国际节点延迟 结果页：每次检测生成一个 sh.cd/results/xxx，可以一键复制链接、导出 Markdown 贴到论坛，终端里 curl 同一个地址也能看 用法 bash <(curl -Ls ) 不带参数进菜单：1 一键全检（约 6 分钟），2 全部检测（约 20 分钟），也可以只测硬件、IP 或网络中的某一项。 说明 bash 3.2 及以上 + curl，Linux 与 macOS 都能跑 只查发起请求的那个出口 IP，不能指定别的 IP，不读取主机名、文件或登录信息 MIT 开源 可以分享两个测试页看一下。 洛杉矶全部检测： 香港 IPv6 + 市级延迟： 基本24小时在线，有任何需求可以去提issue。基本上，很快就解决。

projects.author: imron
projects.summary: Bottle is a ledger that gives AI agents/bots the ability to log facts against custom schemas and query those facts using a fixed set of commands. It's the middle ground for when you want more structure than markdown, but less structure than SQL. I made it because I wanted to give AI agents a way to store and retrieve structured facts for repeated events but didn't want the structure to be defined as prose, didn't want the facts to be stored as prose, and didn't want AI to overcomplicate things with SQL. Maybe you want to track hours worked on projects. Maybe want to track fitness or nutrition data. Maybe you want to track expenses, or leads, or any other form of repeated, structured data, and you want an agent or a bot to do all the tracking. projects.title: Show HN: Intent Based Infrastructure on Top of Terraform
projects.author: rash805115
projects.summary: Hey everyone! I built a platform that works on top of Terraform to expose high level constructs you want to create in your infrastructure (intent) rather than actually dealing with cloud resources (typical terraform modules). I am looking for other enthusiasts to work on this project, and gather feedback. The problem I am trying to solve is complexity. Typically you make infra by either asking AI, or dealing with very low level resources that other people on your team might not fully understand. If you expose a higher level construct, people will only typically deal with a well understood graph of intent which is much easier to understand and reason about, without worrying about low level resources. It works by declaring a model graph that consists of simple nodes like App, Region, Environment, Service, Server, etc that you show your intent with. E.g. My infrastructure consists of 3 AWS accounts (QA, Staging, Prod), with 2 Regions in each, and 1 Environment, under which my Service X resides. The Octo library then converts those intent to actual cloud resources using your instructions. E.g. it would convert a Region node into a vpc + internet-gateway. Or an Environment into an ECS Cluster. It will also generate the Terraform code for each of these cloud resources that your intent wanted. You can then run this Terraform code normally and get your infrastructure. There is a lot more depth, features, and roadmap items to this. Happy to go in more detail.

projects.title: Show HN: dnswer – browser-based DNS change approval and multi-provider sync
projects.author: Quibus99
projects.summary: Imagine you have to manage DNS for domains spread across multiple DNS providers. You want to apply consistent DNS settings across your zones but the only way is applying the same change manually zone by zone (using multiple control panels). Tedious and a mistake is bound to happen. You want to delegate permissions to other teams but many times the only way is handing out access to everything. If something breaks you have no idea who did it and what exactly was changed. The existing solution is IaC. Tools like OctoDNS or DNSControl can help you with some of the problems described above. But they require the whole team to feel at home with setting up pipelines, command line tools and git. With dnswer I want to provide the same level of structure, but in a browser: - staging / preview before publishing DNS changes (edit and publish are separate roles) - reusable blocks of records with per-zone variables (not a one-off template: update once, bulk-upgrade every zone that uses it) - granular access control from full access down to write access on just a single record - multi-provider sync with drift detection and resolution - provision new zones at your provider(s), not only importing existing ones - nameserver verification after changes (verifies that the change is live) - for providers without an API, a shareable change request with on-demand re-verification (viewable without a dnswer account) - modern record types (HTTPS/SVCB) and DANE/TLSA for mail, with cert-drift monitoring - a zone logbook showing what changed, who did it, and why There are a few ways you can learn more about it: - Learn: https://dnswer.net/show/ (walkthroughs; annotated screenshots explaining how to use key features) - Try it: https://app.demo.dnswer.net/ (sandbox with mock providers, free; sign up and verify your email to get in) - Pricing: https://dnswer.net/pricing If you want to try it with your own zones and API access to your DNS provider(s): I'm looking for up to ten teams (ideally managing 20+ domains across multiple providers) willing to manage real zones using dnswer. Not a big beta: I want to watch how it actually gets used and adapt things quickly. Free for the first 3 months, and early users keep their price for 2 years even after it goes up for new customers. If you're interested, reach out by emailing joost@dnswer.net. A few things worth knowing before you do. dnswer is not in your resolution path: your records stay at your provider and your nameservers keep answering. If dnswer is down, DNS keeps resolving and you can still change records directly in your provider's control panel, you just lose the workflow on top until it is back. You can leave whenever you like: every zone exports as a BIND file with your record descriptions preserved as comments, so your documentation comes with you. Your provider credentials are encrypted at rest. I've built it to solve the DNS problems I ran into in the last 20 years. I'd like to learn about other people's DNS problems as well. Tech stack: Django/DRF, PostgreSQL, NATS, Lit web components, deployed with Ansible.

projects.title: Show HN: Kaflow Search – A desktop tool for locally indexed Kafka message search
projects.author: whsoul
projects.summary: For a long time, I’ve used Kafka for services for some purpose. like tracing user action log, event sourcing propagation pipeline step processing and so on. Whenever I use Kafka, I need to set up kafka ecosystem such as, ELK ( Elasticsearch + Logstash + Kibana) for search Kafka messages for service operation, issue trace. and Kafka sink connector for some data forward other persistent DB, and ksqlDB( or Flink ) for count and monitor event stream. With additional infra and software One day, a thought suddenly crossed my mind. That is “Basically Kafka is processing message stream sequentially, with a consumer. It means If I don’t know what the partition and offset of “needle” is, I have to find needle sequentially from beginning. but if I know Kafka message partition and offset, Can I find and access data directly like other DBMS?” ELK is not necessary on my service at that time. Just I need to search trace events and it is in Kafka topic message. All I need to know is where the data I want to find is My desktop and your desktop are too powerful, expensive to use only for web browser operation and AI question agent. Let’s use local disk and local application for indexing storage and search engine about Kafka message. This local-first concept is implemented as “Kaflow Search desktop tool” If you don’t need to keep data for a long time or permanently You don’t have to go through the hassle of installing and managing ELK or other Kafka ecosystem infrastructure Just keep and sync index with Kafka cluster server And find messages you want easily with just this tool installed It will save your operation time. When operating company services, The costs of installing server, managing additional ELK/Kafka Connect, ksqlDB instances didn’t come out of my own pocket so I felt free to spend my time and server resources to set additional data pipeline up. but if it is my own service that I afford, I can’t help saving my server cost. I can’t afford the additional infra costs from cloud service (like AWS) I’m not a rich developer, who just has a laptop to develop software. I’ll make the most of my laptop resources, until my service generates enough money, and then I can handle additional server costs. I’ll only use Kafka and this tool on my service, before I really need ELK and other Kafka ecosystem. I dedicate this rich client Kafka tool to developers who, like me, are poor. From brew ( macOS ) - brew install --cask whsoul/tap/kaflow-search-demo Please try my tool ( on your macOS, Windows ) and feedback for me consumer ID, consumer Group do not remain on your cluster. It does only read operation, not managing function ( such as delete, create topic, repartition cluster topic). It normally only reads once messages that you select, and read local-first index for search your message. So feel free to install this. But it is not developer signed.. (Sorry because I’m poor developer..) Please follow this install guide ( https://github.com/whsoul/kaflow-search#install ) about untrusted developer warning when install and first launch.

projects.summary: DataHub Tools 中文入口： 英文入口： 这是 DataHub 数据社区提供的免费浏览器工具箱。这里以项目方身份自荐，不是第三方测评；也不是同名的开源 DataHub 元数据平台。 比较适合的用途是数据格式转换与整理：把接口返回的 JSON 数组转为 CSV、把 CSV 转成 Markdown 表格，或在文档和表格之间转换数据。也提供开发调试、字幕和图片相关工具，分类入口可以直接浏览。 一个可以直接体验的例子： 输入： json [ {"name":"示例甲","city":"北京","note":"a,b","profile":{"role":"analyst"}}, {"name":"示例乙","city":"上海","note":"hello"} ] 转换后，嵌套对象会展开为 profile.role 列，逗号所在字段会加引号，缺失列补空。这个例子已在当前线上版本实测。 该转换工具无需注册，可在浏览器中直接操作。适合字段较稳定、来源可信的对象数组。页面同时说明局限：字面点号键可能与展开路径冲突；为 CSV 字段加引号不等于消除表格公式注入风险。不建议把未经检查的结果直接当作可信表格打开。 希望听到实际使用反馈，尤其是日常 JSON/CSV/Markdown 整理中尚未覆盖的需求。各工具页面提供反馈入口。

projects.author: eskyle2001
projects.summary: 开源仓库地址： https://github.com/eskim2001/dshcloud 自托管的多用户、多实例平台，用户数据持久化 ## 起源 最近用 dsh 创造模式用的很多，经常就把 dsh 改造成一个完全不同的 app 了，这时候要分享给不太会用的朋友比较麻烦，就想到了把这个部署到云上。没考虑现有的方案主要是第二个问题，dsh 版本更新的很快，希望能方便的更新 dsh ，保留原来的用户数据，于是就想到了做容器化的隔离+mount 持久化。 **什么时候用得上** - 和朋友分享你改造的 dsh：每个 dsh 是一个独立域名 ，数据与配额互相隔离，甚至未来可以作为多租户 - 不想依赖本地设备：跑在自己的 VPS 上持续在线，浏览器从任意设备进 - 想要快速升级新版的 dsh：换镜像升级，升前自动打数据快照，失败能回滚 **具体能力** - workspace 创建/启停/重建/删除：每个 workspace 独立容器 + 持久化存储，CPU 、内存、进程数、磁盘容量都有配额 - 邀请制多用户：管理员发邀请链接加人，没有公开注册 - 访问控制：workspace 端口只绑宿主机回环，外部访问要走 Traefik forward-auth + 归属校验 + 按 workspace 的签名校验 - 版本管理：从 GHCR 同步版本目录、发布稳定版本、配置默认版本 - 控制台：配额查看、用量采样、workspace 日志流 - 界面支持中英文、明暗主题、⌘K 命令菜单 **先在线试试** 在线 demo： https://console.demo.dshcloud.app demo-user 这个 workspace 放了一个 10 块钱的 key ，可以直接测试 现在比较有意思的是这样的，你可以和你的朋友一起用一个账号登录同一个实例，dsh 支持两边都事实更新，这个就有点像一些协作文档一样了，甚至你俩可以在同一个实例里面用 AI 对战之类的，后续会考虑单独做 dsh 的分享功能，现在必须要同一个账号才行 **装在自己服务器上** 需要一台 Linux + Docker Compose （本地用 mac 也可以），放开 80/443 端口，预留磁盘配额： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eskim2001/dshcloud/main/scripts/install.sh | bash ``` **当前状态**：早期开发。可用于评估和开发，打算暴露到公网的话。 有兴趣的点 star ，这里或者 issue 有任何反馈（包括吐槽）都欢迎。

projects.title: Show HN: SeaSearch – Lightweight, S3-backed multi-tenant search engine
projects.author: Daniel-Pan
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm Daniel, co-founder of Seafile. I'm glad to share our open-sourcing project SeaSearch, a search engine written in Go (built on ZincSearch) that we’ve been running in production for over two years for Seafile project. After years of using Elasticsearch, we think there are two main problems with Elasticsearch: It is not lightweight and hard to maintain a cluster All of seafile tenants' data was stored in a single index and it is slow to search a file in a single library because the whole index need to be searched Three years ago, we started developing a solution to solve the two problems. Rather than building a search engine from scratch, we built on top of ZincSearch, that is implemented in Go rather than JVM with a smaller runtime footprint and has Elasticsearch API compatibility, but it was still missing something that we get to find out along the way. We have now open-sourced SeaSearch with the pieces we needed: S3-backed Storage: Index data lives in S3. Compute nodes share the same backend, making scaling/failover instant (no data replication needed). Smart Caching: Uses a local disk cache for immutable segments to keep things fast despite the S3 backend. ES API Compatible: Works as a drop-in replacement for most Elasticsearch query endpoints. Lightweight Go Runtime: No JVM overhead. Vector Search: Built-in support for HNSW/IVFPQ for hybrid semantic search. Hope this helps fellow devs who are stuck in this problem when building multi-tenant SaaS applications. Looking forward to your responses.

projects.summary: Project URL Category Python Project Title ChatDrop: Query WeChat exports from AI tools Project Description A Mac share extension and Python CLI that organize selected WeChat exports in SQLite. Query conversations and dates from AI coding tools, reuse matching messages, and fill missing attachments from later exports. MIT licensed. Highlights Maintainer self-submission. Separates canonical messages from import provenance. A later export can supply a missing video without adding another copy of the matched message. Original files remain available for verification. Useful as a small example of connecting a native sharing extension, file receipts, SQLite and an agent-friendly CLI. Current scope: Apple Silicon Mac; Python 3.9+ for the CLI. Same-minute identical messages exported separately can be ambiguous because matching is not based on WeChat message IDs. ChatDrop itself does not upload chats; external AI tools have their own data handling. I checked the repository URL in the HelloGitHub website search and searched existing GitHub submissions before submitting; no matching result was visible. projects.title: Show HN: Rebuno - An open-source runtime for production agents
projects.author: nnww
projects.summary: I have been building Rebuno, an open-source execution runtime for operating AI agents in production. It manages execution state and guardrails across agents built with different frameworks. Agents run as HTTP services. Rebuno dispatches work through signed webhooks and keeps execution state in Postgres. Agents submit tool and model calls to Rebuno as steps before executing them. For each new step, Rebuno evaluates per-agent YAML policies, independently of the model's prompt. It can allow the call, deny it, or hold it for human approval. The agent executes permitted calls and reports their outcomes. Policy decisions and step outcomes are both recorded in one append-only event log. After an interruption, the agent starts its handler from the top. Steps with recorded outcomes return those outcomes instead of executing again. A crash can also leave a tool with no recorded outcome. Tools marked safe_to_retry run again, and tools marked at_most_once fail as indeterminate. How the agent handles an indeterminate step is up to its implementation. There are Python and TypeScript SDKs, and the repo includes examples using LangChain, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, Vercel AI SDK, and Mastra. Rebuno is free to self-host and released under the MIT licensed. I'd be interested in hearing how others are running or operating agents in production. Blog post with diagrams: https://rebuno.io/blog/introducing-rebuno Getting started: https://docs.rebuno.io/getting-started

github.description: Enterprise SSL/TLS Certificate Automation Platform / 企业证书自动化管理平台

projects.summary: TLSFlow 是什么 证书有效期越来越短，但企业仍常用 Excel、临时脚本和人工 SSH 登录维护证书。TLSFlow 是一个面向企业的 SSL/TLS 证书全生命周期自动化平台，把证书资产、应用资产和部署过程放进同一个可追踪的流程。 核心能力 统一管理证书、服务器、站点、应用和责任人之间的关联关系 支持 PEM、PFX、JKS、P7B 等证书格式及多种证书来源 通过 Agent、SSH、网关和插件工作流覆盖 Windows、Linux、Web 服务器、负载均衡、云平台和隔离网络 自动执行预检、备份、安装、刷新、HTTPS 验证以及失败回滚 提供证书到期提醒、审批、操作审计、执行快照和变更记录 通过插件系统和 Workflow DSL 扩展特殊设备、内部 API 和非标准部署流程 TLSFlow 关注的是证书签发之后最容易失控的环节：证书在哪里、应该部署到哪里、部署是否生效、失败后能否恢复，以及整个过程能否审计。 截图 快速开始 文档： 项目提供 Docker Compose 标准部署和 PGlite 单节点评估模式，适合先在测试环境验证证书资产管理和自动化部署流程。 许可证说明 核心代码默认采用 PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0。商业生产环境使用前，请阅读 LICENSE 并联系权利方获取商业授权。

projects.author: gentpan

github.name: gentpan/OpenStats
github.description: 轻量原生的 macOS 菜单栏系统监控：CPU、GPU、内存、网络、温度，支持风扇调速与防休眠。Swift 6 + SwiftUI，液态玻璃界面。

projects.summary: 大家好，我是 OpenStats 的开发者，想自荐一个开源的 macOS 菜单栏工具。 想在菜单栏抬眼就看到 CPU、风扇、网速，发现问题后直接调风扇、合盖继续跑、清缓存——所以做了这个中文优先、把「看」和「做」放在一起的工具。 菜单栏九种风格：CPU / GPU / 内存 / 网速 / 磁盘 / 电池 / 温度 / 风扇，双行文字、圆环、饼图、柱状历史等可整体或单项指定；数字等宽，刷新不抖动。 详情弹窗：核心热力图、流量历史与 ping、内存水位、电池与蓝牙外设电量等，区块可关。 温度与风扇：读全部传感器；自动 / 降温 / 强冷 / 自定义四种模式，退出后风扇自动恢复。 防休眠与清理：合盖继续跑任务；按类别清理缓存 / 日志 / 安装包等，清理前二次确认。 进程与本机解释：右键「用 Apple 智能解释」由系统本机模型说明（需 macOS 26，不联网）。 隐私与平台：数据本机读取，无统计上报；仅公网 IP 归属地查询与可选 ping 可联网（可关）。Swift + SwiftUI，无第三方 Swift 包依赖；SMC/风扇相关逻辑参考并移植自 exelban/stats（MIT）。MIT 开源，Developer ID 签名并公证。macOS 14+，Apple Silicon 上开发测试，Intel 风扇与温度未验证。界面有简体中文和英文。

See more details: https://tokencanopy.com/products/agentdrive Try the beta: https://app.tokencanopy.com/drive/ For MCP clients: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user agentdrive https://drive.mcp.tokencanopy.com/mcp claude mcp login agentdrive codex mcp add agentdrive --url https://drive.mcp.tokencanopy.com/mcp codex mcp login agentdrive A public API/SDK integration experience is on the roadmap so that you can use AgentDrive in your product, but it is not available as a beta user interface today. We’d especially appreciate feedback on: 1. Was connecting and using AgentDrive through MCP clear? 2. Which tools or storage primitives are missing? 3. What would be the first workflow you ask your agents do with AgentDrive? Open source repo is also on the roadmap so that you can host it on your own infrastructure! Sign up at tokencanopy.com for more future updates. Any feedback or feature requests can be sent to support@team.tokencanopy.com. You can reach out to me directly at josh@tokencanopy.com I'd love to personally connect with more founders and developers who are building in the coding agent infra space: https://github.com/jiashuoz

projects.title: Show HN: Pull every comment out of a Google Sheet, in the browser
projects.author: bsunter2
projects.summary: I spend a lot of time working in Google sheets. Often, I will collaborate with up to 50 other people in the same workbook. One specific org I worked at had a strong preference for using comment threads in Sheets extensively to ask questions, give feedback, and raise risks. Sheets would regularly get 70+ comment threads across multiple tabs with dozens of contributing teams. As the owner of the sheet, I wanted a way to document the comments to retain traceability on all of the various conversations. To my surprise, there was no function built into sheets to scrape, count, sort or manage comments at all. I also couldnt find any good third party add-ons to solve the problem. So I built one myself. I discovered that the Drive API gives you the comment text, author and state, but doesnt give the location of the comment which was crucial. Thankfully, the .xlsx export has xl/threadedComments with the cell reference, timestamp, author, resolved flag and parent ID. How it runs: JSZip in the browser, no sign-in, nothing uploaded anywhere. I am in the process of having the app verified to be hosted on Google Workspace Marketplace, but in the mean time the tool is available at: https://github.com/bsunter93/commentpulse

projects.summary: 前几天分享了 PixelBridge ，用 Mac 给 Apple 照片多做一份备份。后来收到一些反馈，发现我默认大家都有 iCloud 和一台常开的 Mac ，其实不是。 有人现在的流程是：iPhone → NAS → Pixel → Google 相册。NAS 在这里主要承担中转，用户真正想要的就是 iPhone 直接传到 Pixel 。 于是另开了一个项目 PhotoBridge： iPhone / Mac → Wi-Fi → Pixel → Google 相册 支持照片、视频、Live Photo 和连拍，可以导入已有图库，也可以增量备份新照片。Live Photo 会在接收端转换为支持的 Motion Photo ，已经在 Pixel 和 Google 相册网页版验证过播放。 这次也把发送和接收拆开了。发送端负责从系统图库取照片，接收端负责保存，以及需要时做格式转换。核心传输、校验、续传和队列共用 Rust ，各平台用原生能力处理图库和后台任务：Apple 端是 SwiftUI ，Android 端是 Kotlin 。 这样以后增加 Windows 发送端、NAS 接收端，或者让 Android 也能发送，就可以沿用同一套传输核心。目前先把 iPhone / Mac 到 Android 这条链路做好。 Mac 和 Android 已有安装包，Mac 支持菜单栏和自动更新。iOS 暂时需要 Mac + Xcode 自行安装，还没有 App Store / TestFlight 版本；后台上传受 iOS 调度影响。 官网： https://photobridge-app.vercel.app 源码： https://github.com/qhhonx/photobridge 之前的 PixelBridge 帖子： https://v2ex.com/t/1240526 目前是 Beta ，源码公开，个人非商业使用免费。Google 相册的空间权益取决于 Pixel 型号，文件传到手机和云端备份完成也是两回事。 欢迎手里有旧 Pixel 的朋友试试，也感谢之前分享实际使用流程的朋友，确实让我看到了自己用法之外的需求。

github.description: Browser-based audio/video toolkit: convert, trim, extract audio and compress, powered by FFmpeg.wasm. Files never leave your device.

projects.summary: 把 FFmpeg 编译成 WebAssembly 放在浏览器里运行，音视频的格式转换、片段截取、音频提取、压缩全部在本地完成，文件不上传服务器。 为什么值得分享：主流在线音视频工具都在服务器上跑 FFmpeg，所以普遍有 50–100MB 的大小上限、每日次数限制和会员制，文件也确实会过一遍别人的硬盘。这个工具把算力搬回了用户自己的设备，没有上传过程，也就没有这些限制；同格式截取与 MP4→AAC 提取走流复制，几秒完成且画质零损失。技术上值得一说的是单/多线程内核按 SharedArrayBuffer 可用性自动切换，以及分辨率按短边计算以避免竖屏被放大。 已知限制：速度取决于设备（浏览器内为软件编码，无硬件加速）；不做裁剪、旋转、变速。

projects.author: luhuadong

github.name: luhuadong/prox
github.description: prox is a simple, safe, and diagnosable proxy environment manager for Linux terminals.

projects.summary: prox 为 Linux 终端提供一套简单、可靠、可诊断的代理开关。它不提供代理服务，也不管理 Clash、V2Ray、企业代理或 VPN。它只负责安全地设置当前终端及其子进程使用的代理环境变量，并检查配置的代理是否可用。 Linux 终端程序通常通过 httpproxy、httpsproxy 和 ALLPROXY 等环境变量使用代理。很多用户会直接在 .bashrc 中写入： bash export ALLPROXY=" 设置变量并不难，麻烦的是代理的生命周期：代理软件退出或端口不可用后，Git、curl 和包管理器仍会连接这个失效地址；手动开启和清除变量又容易遗漏，还可能覆盖终端原有的代理配置。 prox 将这些操作统一为一系列命令： prox on 在修改当前终端环境前检查代理端点，连接失败时保持环境不变； prox off 恢复启用前的代理变量，而不是简单地全部清空； prox status 显示当前 Shell 的代理状态，并识别变量是否被其他操作修改； prox check 检查配置、代理端口以及通过代理访问网络是否正常； prox run -- <command> 只让一条命令及其子进程使用代理，不修改当前 Shell。 prox 使用 Go 编写，发布为单个二进制文件，不依赖 curl、nc、jq，也不需要后台守护进程。项目还提供预编译包、deb、rpm 和 Bash completion。
